title: Restyle Energy Balance Video with Physical Fundamentals Glyphs

Every factor animates 0-1, every equation term is the result of the physical picture, formulas typeset with math_label/math_panel, ideas morph into each other, no overlaps, animations synced with subtitles. Deliver the full video at 1080p60.
